operations.comment: ; Execution views: switchable routines shown at $8000/$A000 use physical PRG
; banks 0/1. Fixed routines at $C000/$E000 use physical banks 14/15. Their
; mapped lower slots can change; SelectPrgPair selects logical pairs, whereas
; review.json retains effective physical 8 KiB banks per classified fragment.
; Cross-bank callees are named only for the established local view.
; Shared NES hardware and mechanically established RAM roles.
; RAM arrays use slot, 2*slot or 3*slot indices as documented at selectors.
; X/Y positions have fraction, low integer and high integer bytes; velocities
; are signed 8.8 fixed point. Player is slot 0; secondary action uses slot 1.
; Scratch names are temporary aliases, not simultaneous persistent fields.
; Addressed private/scene fields retain mechanical names where game meaning is unknown.
; iNES header: mapper 4, 128 KiB PRG, 128 KiB CHR, horizontal mirroring; no trainer. Header is
; retained verbatim.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Restart through the fixed reset entry. This lower-bank vector assumes physical PRG banks 0/1 are
; mapped.
; InitializeRun
; Initialize run counters, health, lives, ammunition and scene/debug state. Clear entities,
; initialize player motion, then enter presentation setup. The continuation sets scene banks and loads the initial descriptor.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Set scene CHR/raster defaults and load the initial scene descriptor at $B93F. This continues run
; initialization.
; RunFrame
; Wait for a frame and update pause/input, camera streaming, player actions, entity handlers,
; rendering, event conditions and debug controls. Health below $10 initiates the player-loss
; path. The exit flag transfers to a separate presentation path.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Restore the gameplay PRG pair, then resume run initialization after the presentation sequence.
; AdvanceScriptedInput
; In mode 1, advance the input pointer once every eight frames while no button is pending. Byte
; $10 ends this input mode; other bytes become controller-1 state.
; UpdatePlayer
; Skip motion while paused. Select player slot 0, apply camera centering and wall checks,
; integrate horizontal motion unless blocked, then apply vertical terrain physics. Active-player
; bit gates entity motion and behavior dispatch.
; ChooseCameraLimits
; Compare the camera position with the left and right world limits. Clamp at either edge and
; record its sign; select the corresponding player screen thresholds. Default thresholds are $58
; and $A8.
; TickPlayerTimers
; Count down the action/recovery timers. During the first timer, a negative vertical velocity
; may be halved; action-state bits alter that countdown. The exact game role of the first timer
; remains tentative.
; ApproachHorizontalVelocity
; Move the selected entity horizontal velocity toward its target by a bounded step. Player
; form and special-surface state change the step; crossing the target snaps to it. Signed 16-bit differences
; select direction.
; IntegratePlayerHorizontal
; Clamp player screen position to the selected camera thresholds. Otherwise add horizontal
; velocity to camera position, sign extending into the third byte. Apply scripted camera drift,
; subtract it from player screen position and reconstruct world X as camera plus screen
; position.
; TickQueuedPatch
; When enabled, count down the patch timer and reload its period. The timer clears a queued command byte, appends the saved address/count/data, rotates the
; patch buffer and disables a nonrepeating patch.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Append the saved PPU address, byte count and patch bytes to the queue. Rotate the patch buffer by
; adjacent XOR swaps; disable it when the repeat flag is clear. The caller supplies queue cursor X.
; DispatchPlayerActions
; Debounce input, handle forced direction, then scan action tables. One table matches the full
; input byte; another selects entries whose mask does not intersect it. Synthetic return
; addresses let indirect handlers return into the scans. Certain player animation kinds invoke
; bounded health damage.
; Two selector/action tables use three-byte records and zero terminals; the first ends at physical
; $4C3. The trailing selector table is separate. The action scanner consumers establish data rather
; than instruction storage.
; UpdateActionFlags
; Clear the first action flag when the player is unsupported. An active secondary action accepts
; only particular animation kinds, sets velocity and chooses an animation descriptor by player
; state and facing. Exact action identity is unresolved.
; SetHorizontalIntent
; Select signed target horizontal velocity and facing for opposite direction handlers.
; Supported/unsupported state chooses animation or direction update. Special movement bits
; redirect to vertical-action handlers.
; ChooseIdleAnimation
; For a supported player, stop target movement and select a descriptor from posture,
; recent-action timer and actual horizontal velocity. The descriptor names are unresolved, but
; state selection is explicit.
; MoveAlongSpecialSurface
; Debug mode moves Y directly. Otherwise, when state and support permit, set signed horizontal
; and vertical velocities and choose a common animation; direction bit controls the sign.
; BeginThrownAction
; Require no active secondary action, an available secondary slot and nonzero ammunition.
; Consume one unit, stop target horizontal movement, set action flag and select a descriptor.
; Facing selects which side receives the secondary entity. Probably the observed bomb action.
; PositionSecondaryEntity
; Position secondary slot 1 above and to either side of the player. State bit 2 chooses the two
; offset pairs; facing chooses the side. Preserve high-byte carry/borrow for world coordinates.
; InitializeSecondaryEntity
; Clear secondary velocities, set its private field to $4B and install descriptor $A4D9 in slot
; 1. The following action entry has its own state and health preconditions.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Set player facing through the shared helper and copy vertical velocity into secondary motion,
; limiting an upward velocity to signed $FE80 before joining action setup.
; BeginJump
; Choose at least $0180 target horizontal speed, reject an incompatible action and select jump
; velocity/animation by player state. Set airborne bit; supported state nudges Y upward and
; requests a sound. Probably the jump seen during input tests.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Require form bit 2 and an active secondary-action state before taking the alternate action path.
; ChooseFastMovement
; Reject incompatible action bits. Low health redirects into ordinary movement. Otherwise choose
; positive horizontal target speed, optionally initialize upward motion and install the selected
; animation.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Reject incompatible action/surface states and require health at least $13. Latch the action and
; choose upward velocity from form and private state before rejoining animation selection.
; UpdateOppositeSpecialMotion
; Debug mode moves Y downward. Otherwise stop or reverse horizontal intent according to player
; support and state; special mode initializes matching signed horizontal and vertical
; velocities. Exact game action remains unresolved.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Call the pickup scan before continuing the surrounding player action.
; TogglePlayerForm
; Only toggle state bit 2 while stationary, supported and not already latched. Set a latch to
; prevent repeated toggles. This probably controls the character/special-form selection;
; identity is unverified.
; CenterPlayerOnScreen
; When no scripted drift is active and selected animation/support conditions hold, move player
; screen X toward $80 in one-pixel steps. Apply the inverse adjustment to camera position so
; world X stays unchanged.
; CheckPlayerBelowScreen
; If the vertical high byte is zero and Y reaches $F0, clear the loss selector and enter the
; player-loss path. Other classified fragments here simply return.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Return from pickup scanning; the following entry handles the signed horizontal-distance filter.
; Take the absolute horizontal difference, reject distances at least four here, and continue with the
; next candidate when the high byte is nonzero.
; Scan slots 1..15 for four collectible types. Require matching Y and a small horizontal distance on
; the permitted side, then apply health, ammunition, life or special-state rewards and clear the
; collected slot.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; After saturated healing, enter the shared pickup sound and removal path.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Type $88 adds ammunition up to 99; $A8 restores health and adds a life up to nine. The remaining
; type sets auxiliary state and requests two sounds. Each accepted reward clears its entity.
; BeginPlayerLoss
; Clear flash timer and active-player state, disable sound output and call the audio reset path.
; The continuation animates loss, waits, consumes a life and reloads the scene or shows game over.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Clear motion and drift, optionally wait through the loss animation, then animate the selected player
; form. After 120 frames restore scene descriptor and health, consume a life and reload; exhausted
; lives show the game-over presentation and restart.
; DamagePlayer
; Ignore damage while the cooldown is nonzero. Otherwise subtract A from player health with
; saturation at zero, set a 15-frame cooldown and a 16-frame flash timer.
; Static entry view: physical PRG banks [0, 1, 14, 15]; natural reachability unresolved.
; Add A to player health, saturating carry or values above $C0 at $C0. Return the stored health in A.
; DebouncePlayerInput
; Propagate stable controller state through three history bytes before updating action input.
; Returns early on the first changed stage, preventing a brief transition from immediately
; becoming an action.
; ApplyForcedDirection
; Forced-direction values 1 and 2 discard this call return address and enter opposite movement
; handlers. Refresh the action timer before redirecting; other values return normally.
; InitializePlayerMotion
; Clear player fixed-point positions, velocities, action input history and timers. Retain state
; bit 2, set active state, place screen X at $80 and Y at $D0, and establish camera thresholds.
; SavePlayerEventPosition
; Save previous player world X, select a per-page event list and scan commands through the event
; cursor. Opcodes 0..5 test crossing direction, position inequalities or absolute proximity.
; Matching records call an indirect handler with a synthetic return address; record length
; controls the next cursor. The bounded page/record lists are explained at their data; individual event game meanings remain tentative.
